sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Twenty-four recreationally trained adults trained one leg with 8 and the other with 16 weekly sets for 10 weeks.

sec.title: Results and Discussion
sec.p: Quadriceps cross-sectional area increased 7.4% (8 sets) and 7.9% (16 sets), p = 0.61.

sec.title: Conclusions
sec.p: Beyond 8 weekly sets, more volume added little.

sec.title: Competing interests
sec.p: Larch L is a consultant for a supplement company.
